resolution: Implemented real UV-vertex editing and fixed-atlas sampling. UV handles now sit on unique authored triangle/polygon vertices; shared fan corners move together; commits send a complete face-ordered Float32 corner table through a validated atomic host boundary; island rectangles are re-derived metadata. Removed the UV selection fill/bounding handles and retired the legacy atlas-writing face-selection tint in favor of the existing screen-space overlay, so selection cannot mask or carry texture colors. Added TS regressions for exact handles/corners and Zig regressions proving deformed faces sample multiple fixed texture colors while the atlas hash remains unchanged.
